review.reviewer: Codex under owner instruction to fix, merge and ship; independent Hermes and debrief_review review
review.conclusion: No material blockers in final shortcut, CSS, behavior changes, and Foreign Affairs source fix. Candidate runtime is unchanged between image source and qualification test source: the only differences are three test files, explicitly listed. Corrected strict PostgreSQL fixtures and replacement-only news discovery fixture passed in full scopes. Candidate includes concurrent main runtime changes through d53a5919e508c0e4c11b5335a2f89344d5c597fa; the two additional Meri state-bill API suites passed in integration qualification. Orchestrator changes are present in Git history but no orchestrator image or service is part of this release.
review.retirementCompatibility: 9 build-isolation workflows and retired bypass controls validated; 37 release policy/operator tests passed; API and Intel runtime imports passed inside candidate images with network disabled. No restored Hermes runtime or production schema modification.
review.landingShortcut: One Watchlist & alerts button beside Settings opens the canonical client-scoped watchlist setup route. Selected client is retained.
review.browserQualificationBeforeRelease: Desktop and 390px mobile local UI checked through browser Playwright controls. Production browser acceptance follows actual promotion.
review.qualificationEnvironment: Native ARM64 CodeBuild; disposable PostgreSQL 16 and pgvector, API/Intel/Workspace migration histories. No production database migrations.
review.githubActions: Actions ended in startup_failure before jobs; these are not passing CI evidence. Equivalent required LegiWatch job scopes executed in CodeBuild with strict summary assertions.

operationalLimits: Source health does not certify all publisher news paths: JCT access fails with 403 and six configured RSS feeds remain failed.

Foreign Affairs current published press index is prioritized and deduplicated within the existing fetch budget. Original obsolete secondary endpoint failure stays visible with recovery provenance; scoped production ingestion acceptance follows promotion.
Unattended restricted-source capture still requires source clearance. Existing browser-only sources are not represented as server-recordable.
Missing retained media and unavailable substantive analysis are not recreated or fabricated; fragment intelligence remains provisional.
This qualification supports the code release, not a claim that every source is healthy, all data is complete, or every hearing is recorded.
